notes.subject: hara tse pedi tsa Ulai
notes.rationale: bein ulai: 'between the Ulai' kapa 'between the banks of the Ulai' — KJV eketsa 'banks', YLT siea feela 'hara Ulai'.

notes.subject: sebono
notes.rationale: hamar'eh ke 'ponahalo/sethingo' — ponahalo eo e bonweng, eseng 'toro'.

notes.subject: להלז
notes.rationale: 'ya mong le mong' — lentswe la Sesotho le hlokahala; Seheberu le tshwere ka lentswe le le leng feela.

notes.subject: tse pedi
notes.rationale: bein ke 'hara' ka bobedi — 'tse pedi tsa Ulai' ho hlalosa 'hara mekokoana' eo KJV e eentseng; Sesotho se hloka ho hlakisa.

translation: Mme ke utlile modumo wa motho hara tse pedi tsa Ulai, mme a bitsa, mme a re: Gavriyele, utlwisisa ⟨את⟩ sebono sena ho ya mong le mong.
